## Triage: p3 · `domain:ui` · `pm:queue` · triage seat · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-18T09:20Z

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015). ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Fresh read on objectui `origin/main` `03f1d65289`:**
  - `packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx:5034` compares `sortedNames(hiddenFields) !== sortedNames(schema.hiddenFields)`;
  - `packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx:3283` and `:3289` relay `viewPref?.hiddenFields` into the list schema.
  The premise holds.
- **Grade p3.** It is a disabled control, and two working ways back (**Show all**, and the header's **Reset view**) are measured on the card. The maintainer's standing word for a narrow item is 「不严重，不处理」. It stays on the queue at the lowest grade, not closed, because the control states something false.
- **For the lane:** density is the same shape by source reading. If the fix reads the view's authored value for one setting, it reads it for both.

## ACCEPT · `domain:ui` seat 2 · `session_01XVp19E1MYUTFM3dnkwz8gB` · 2026-10-18T10:23Z

PR #12953 at head `60cb012`, reviewed against the claim `6248223082` (amended to `Clause-②: yes`), triage `6248174986`, the dev reports `6248499536` and `6248615838`, and the contract review `6248559044`.

- **What changed:** `ListView`'s Display control compares hidden fields and grid density against the view's own value when a host passes the new optional host prop `viewDefaults` (`Pick<ListViewSchema, 'hiddenFields' | 'rowHeight'>`), and against `schema` otherwise, exactly as before. The trigger count follows the same comparison, and "Reset to view default" writes the view's value back through `updateHiddenFields` / `density.setMode`, so the user's stored preference follows (one preference save, no view write). The console's `ObjectView` passes the view's authored values: `viewDef.hiddenFields` on a view that declares `columns`, `undefined` on an unprojected saved view (objectui#12505) and on a system view, and the `normalizeListViewSchema`-folded `rowHeight`. The objectui#12423 docblock now states the user-preference overlay (objectui#12474) as the reason.
- **Clause-②:** `yes (widening)`: the claim was amended in place on the dev's measurement; changeset `@object-ui/plugin-list: minor`, `@object-ui/app-shell: patch`. No key is added to `ListViewSchema` in `@object-ui/types`.
- **Contract review:** PASS `6248559044` at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` on head `388e1f9`: `viewDefaults` is the only public-surface change; an absent prop is behaviourally unchanged; the passed semantics match `resolvedDensity`'s resolution; each `ObjectView` path hands the right authored value; `minor` / `patch` are right. Its one escalation, the README for `viewDefaults` (AGENTS.md commandment 2), was carried on this branch as a patch round rather than a follow-up.
- **Patch round (`60cb012`, prose only):** `packages/plugin-list/README.md` gains a "Host prop: `viewDefaults`" section beside `toolbarLeading` and `compact`, matching the code (purpose, whole-baseline semantics, absent = unchanged, a host prop and not a schema key) with one example compiled by `check:doc-snippets` (804 / 804 blocks). No `content/docs/**` page documents `ListView`'s host props (`content/docs/plugins/plugin-list.mdx` defers to the README), so none was changed. The code the review judged is unchanged since `388e1f9`.
- **Tests:** `ListView.displayResetBaseline-12949.test.tsx` (7) pins enabled-on-mount, count, the write of the view's set, empty-set semantics, density, both-differ, a same-value CONTROL and a no-prop CONTROL; `ObjectView.userListState-12418` gains 4 relay pins (system view, write-back through both doors, other-user CONTROL, unprojected saved view). Ablation of the comparison turns the hidden-field pins red; restore proven by blob hash. The plugin-list families (185 tests) and app-shell families (162 tests) pass; type-check and the pre-tsc battery exit 0. The full `packages/plugin-list/` and `packages/app-shell/` directories are declared to CI.
- **Acceptance notes:** the first commit's body carries the prose line "Fixes objectui#12949 via the PR." beside the PR body's `Fixes #12949`; same card, not a trailer, left as is (no force-push in this repo).
- **Trailers:** both commits on the code head and the README commit carry only the model-free pair.
- **CI at head:** all 36 check-runs on `60cb012` are complete: 33 success, 3 skipped (dependabot and the two coverage jobs), none failed; `mergeable_state: clean`. Path surface (6 files, +335 / −10): `packages/plugin-list/**`, `packages/app-shell/src/views/**` and one changeset, no governed path.

## Landed · `domain:ui` seat 2 · `session_01XVp19E1MYUTFM3dnkwz8gB` · 2026-10-18T10:38Z

PR #12953 merged through the merge queue as `b5153f44eaea93c4f7e29117d3022297f31bab91`, which is on `main`; `Fixes #12949` closes this card. Verified by content: all 6 of the PR's files on `main` are blob-identical to the accepted head `60cb012`. The merge commit's message names no model.

What landed:
- On a console list, "Reset to view default" and the Display trigger's count compare hidden fields and density against the view's own value, so after a user hides a column (or changes density) and reloads, the reset is enabled and hands the view's value back, with the user's stored preference following.
- `@object-ui/plugin-list: minor`: `ListViewProps` gains the optional host prop `viewDefaults` (documented in the package README); a host that does not pass it is unchanged. `@object-ui/app-shell: patch`. Contract review PASS `6248559044`.

For hotcrm: objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2123's grids (with `userActions.hideFields` from objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2149) get a working reset once the console build HotCRM runs carries the merge commit above. This seat now removes `pm:dispatched`.
